Adjustment.description: One labelled adjustment of Appendix C, tagged by `kind` (R10).

oneOf.description: B.I, B.II, C.II or C.III to non-operating assets.

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

oneOf.description: C.II to the net financial position (other financial asset).

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

maturity.description: `within_one_year` or `beyond_one_year`, for the parts of the net financial position.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

oneOf.description: Cash of the net financial position to operating working capital.

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

oneOf.description: E to the net financial position (other financial liability).

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

oneOf.description: Payables D to the net financial position (other financial liability).

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

oneOf.description: Provisions B or C to debt-like items.

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

oneOf.description: A5 or B14 to the investing result.

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

related_non_operating_asset.description:
Label of the non-operating asset the income or expense relates to, if any;
reported only.

oneOf.description: An income statement aggregate to the non-recurring result.

aggregate.description: Source aggregate of Appendix A.2; D18 and D19 are not accepted (R17).

amounts.description:
One entry per year, in the order of `years`: the amount in currency units, zero
or more, or null where the adjustment does not apply (reported). Only for
statutory entries.

label.description: What the adjustment is, for example "Idle warehouse"; not blank.

reason.description: Why it is made; not blank (R10).

BridgeClaim.description:
A claim on the value of the company other than the net financial position, subtracted from
enterprise value to reach equity value: a debt-like item or a non-controlling interest
(R25). Fairmark subtracts the amount as given and does not choose how it is measured.

basis_note.description:
Free text that qualifies the basis, for example "net of tax" or "49% of the book value
of equity of the subsidiary"; required with `other`, optional otherwise, never empty
when given. Reported, never used in the calculation.

label.description:
What the claim is, for example "Unfunded pension obligation" or "30% of Subsidiary A".
Not empty.

measurement_basis.description:
How the amount was measured, stated by the analyst: `book_value`, `market_value`,
`fair_value`, `present_value` or `other` (then describe it in `basis_note`). Required,
no default. Reported with the amount, never used in the calculation.

value.description: Amount at the valuation date, in currency units, zero or more; subtracted.

Date.description: Calendar date, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, from 1900-01-01 to 2199-12-31.

depreciation_and_amortisation.description:
B10 a and b, amortisation of intangible and depreciation of tangible assets, in
currency units.

value_adjustments_of_fixed_assets.description:
B10 a to c as one amount, as grouped by the abridged layout (art. 2435-bis), in
currency units. Without `write_downs_of_fixed_assets` it is read as depreciation and
amortisation, reported (R17).

write_downs_of_fixed_assets.description: B10 c, other write-downs of fixed assets, in currency units; in the investing result.

write_downs_of_receivables.description:
B10 d, write-downs of current receivables and cash, in currency units; in the investing
result, or in `operating_profit` with `treatments.write_downs_of_receivables:
operating` (R17).

DerivativeLiabilitiesDestination.description: Destination of the derivative liabilities within provisions B, Decision 5.

oneOf.description: An other financial liability of the net financial position.
Operating provisions, with the other provisions B.

Equity.description: Equity, liabilities A, as a total or by its Roman numerals.

cash_flow_hedge_reserve.description: A.VII cash flow hedge reserve, in currency units, signed.

legal_reserve.description: A.IV legal reserve, in currency units.

negative_reserve_for_own_shares.description: A.X negative reserve for own shares held, in currency units, zero or negative.

other_reserves.description:
A.VI other reserves, including the rounding reserve of statements in euro units, in
currency units, signed.

profit_or_loss_for_the_year.description: A.IX profit (loss) for the year, in currency units, signed; checked against item 21.

retained_earnings.description: A.VIII retained earnings (losses carried forward), in currency units, signed.

revaluation_reserves.description: A.III revaluation reserves, in currency units.

share_capital.description: A.I share capital, in currency units.

share_premium.description: A.II share premium reserve, in currency units.

statutory_reserves.description: A.V statutory reserves, in currency units.

total.description: Total equity A, in currency units, signed (negative for a deficit).

FinancialFixedAssetsDestination.description: Destination of financial fixed assets (B.III), Decision 10.

oneOf.description: Strategic holdings used by the business: operating fixed assets.
Surplus holdings: non-operating assets, outside invested capital, for the bridge.
Financial investments: an other financial asset of the net financial position.

FinancialFixedAssetsOverride.description: Another treatment of financial fixed assets for one year: one destination, or a split.

oneOf.description: One destination for the whole of B.III this year.
Parts with their destinations, summing to B.III of the year.

FinancialFixedAssetsPart.description: One part of a split of financial fixed assets for one year.

amount.description: Amount of this part, in currency units, zero or more. The parts sum to B.III.

label.description:
What the part is, for example "Shares in a listed company"; not blank. Used as the
label of the non-operating asset or of the item of the net financial position.

Layout.description: The statutory layout, echoed in the result; no number depends on it.

oneOf.description: Ordinary layout, art. 2424 and 2425 of the Civil Code.

LeaseAmounts.description: Amounts of a `lease` adjustment for one year (R21, financial method).

asset.description: Right-of-use asset added to operating fixed assets, in currency units.

depreciation.description: Depreciation of the right-of-use asset for the year, in currency units.

interest.description: Interest on the lease liability for the year, added to C17, in currency units.

liability.description: Lease liability added to the net financial position, in currency units.

liability_current.description: Of which due within the next financial year, in currency units.

payments.description: Lease payments of the year removed from B8, in currency units.

prepayment.description: Prepayment (maxicanone) removed from prepayments, in currency units.

Line.description: A labelled amount, for example an asset and its realisable value.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Land" or "Bank loan". Not empty.

value.description: Amount in currency units, zero or positive.

Maturity.description: Maturity of a financial receivable or of tax instalments.

oneOf.description: Due within the next financial year (current).
Due beyond the next financial year (non-current).

MeasurementBasis.description:
How the amount of a bridge claim was measured (Decision 21). Fairmark does not choose the
basis: the analyst states it and the result reports it next to the amount.

oneOf.description: Book value per the accounts at the valuation date.
Quoted market price at the valuation date.
Fair value as defined by IFRS 13.
Present value of the obligation, for example unfunded pensions or provisions.

NetFinancialPosition.description:
The net financial position with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6). Fairmark adds what is
given and does not choose which items are included.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents, in currency units, subtracted from the gross debt.

gross_debt.description: Gross financial debt (bank loans, bonds and other borrowings), in currency units.

other_items.description: Other items included by the analyst, each added with its sign. Default: none.

NetFixedAsset.description: A fixed asset shown net of accumulated amortisation, depreciation and write-downs.

accumulated.description: Accumulated amortisation or depreciation and write-downs, in currency units.

gross.description: Gross amount (historical cost and revaluations), in currency units.

total.description:
Net carrying amount, in currency units. Checked against `gross − accumulated` when all
three are given.

NfpItem.description: One item of the net financial position other than gross debt and cash.

amount.description:
Amount in currency units, added to the net financial position: positive for debt-like
items, negative for financial assets.

name.description: What the item is, for example "lease liabilities" or "derivative assets".

NonRecurringSource.description:
Source of a `non_recurring` adjustment: an income statement aggregate of Appendix A.2 that
accepts it. D18 and D19 are fixed in the investing result and cannot be moved (R17).

OperatingWorkingCapital.description: Operating working capital, as a total or by its components.

other_operating_assets.description:
Other operating assets (other receivables, prepayments, operating cash), in currency
units.

other_operating_liabilities.description: Other operating liabilities (other payables, accruals), in currency units.

total.description: Operating working capital, in currency units, signed; checked against its components.

Payables.description: Payables, liabilities D, with their "of which" parts.

accruals_and_deferred_income.description:
Of which accruals and deferred income (liabilities E presented within D,
art. 2435-bis), in currency units; when given without a separate line E, that line is
zero. Not given: none within D (D2), listed in `meta.defaults_applied`.

beyond_one_year.description:
Of which due beyond the next financial year, in currency units; needed for the current
and non-current block.

financial_debt.description:
Of which financial debt (bonds, banks, other lenders: D.1, D.2, D.4, D.5), with its
part beyond one year; needed for the net financial position (Decision 4).

shareholder_loans.description:
Of which shareholder loans (D.3), with its part beyond one year; needed for the net
financial position, and needs the treatment `shareholder_loans` when not zero.

total.description: Payables D, in currency units, including the parts below.

trade.description: Of which trade payables, in currency units; needed for `trade_working_capital`.

Provisions.description: Provisions for risks and charges, liabilities B.

beyond_one_year.description:
Of which due beyond the next financial year, in currency units. Not given: all
non-current, reported.

of_which_derivative_liabilities.description:
Of which derivative liabilities (B.3), in currency units; needs the treatment
`derivative_liabilities` when not zero. Not given: none within B (D2, D3), listed in
`meta.defaults_applied`.

total.description: Provisions B, in currency units, including the derivative part.

beyond_one_year.description:
Of which due beyond the next financial year, in currency units; needed for the current
and non-current block.

prepayments_and_accrued_income.description:
Of which prepayments and accrued income (assets D presented within C.II,
art. 2435-bis), in currency units; when given without a separate line D, that line is
zero. Not given: none within C.II (D2), listed in `meta.defaults_applied`.

subscribed_capital_unpaid.description:
Of which subscribed capital unpaid (item A presented within C.II, art. 2435-bis), in
currency units; deducted from equity. Not given: none within C.II (D2), listed in
`meta.defaults_applied`.

total.description: Receivables C.II, in currency units, including the parts below.

trade.description: Of which trade receivables, in currency units; needed for `trade_working_capital`.

Reclassified.description: A year in the reclassified form: totals already reorganised (Appendix B, R5).

ReclassifiedBalanceSheet.description:
Reclassified balance sheet totals, the output fields of Appendix B.1 (R5). Each is
optional; every total its formula allows is derived from what is given and checked against
a total given.

debt_like_items.description:
Debt-like items, each a label, an amount in currency units and its measurement basis
(the `dcf.fcff` bridge type). An empty list states that there are none.

invested_capital.description:
Invested capital, operating fixed assets + operating working capital − operating
provisions, in currency units, signed.

net_financial_position.description: Net financial position, as a total, the SPEC-0007 object, or both.

non_operating_assets.description:
Non-operating assets, each a label and a carrying amount in currency units (zero or
more). An empty list states that there are none.

operating_fixed_assets.description: Operating fixed assets, in currency units.

operating_provisions.description:
Operating provisions (provisions and employee severance indemnity treated as
operating), in currency units.

operating_working_capital.description: Operating working capital, as a total or by its components.

quasi_equity_items.description:
Quasi-equity items (for example subordinated shareholder loans), each a label and an
amount in currency units. An empty list states that there are none.

total_funds_invested.description:
Total funds invested, invested capital + Σ non-operating assets, in currency units,
signed.

total_sources.description:
Total sources, equity + Σ quasi-equity items + net financial position + Σ debt-like
items, in currency units, signed.

ReclassifiedIncomeStatement.description:
Reclassified income statement totals, the output fields of Appendix B.2 (R5). Each is
optional.

depreciation_and_amortisation.description: Depreciation and amortisation (B10 a, b), in currency units.

ebitda.description: EBITDA (MOL), value added − personnel costs, in currency units, signed.

financing_result.description: Financing result, C17-bis − C17, in currency units, signed.

income_taxes.description: Income taxes (item 20), in currency units, signed.

interest_and_other_financial_charges.description: Interest and other financial charges (C17), in currency units.

investing_result.description: Investing result (accessory area), in currency units, signed.

materials_consumed.description: Materials consumed (B6 + B11), in currency units, signed.

net_income.description: Net income (item 21), in currency units, signed.

non_recurring_result.description: Non-recurring result, in currency units, signed.

operating_profit.description: Operating profit (reddito operativo, MON), in currency units, signed.

profit_before_financing_and_taxes.description:
Profit before financing and income taxes, operating profit + investing result, in
currency units, signed.

profit_before_tax.description: Profit before tax, in currency units, signed.

value_added.description: Value added, value of production − external costs, in currency units, signed.

value_of_production.description: Value of production (A, core), in currency units, signed.

ReclassifiedNetFinancialPosition.description:
The net financial position of a reclassified balance sheet: a total, the SPEC-0007 object,
or both, and optionally its current and non-current parts.

current.description: Part due within the next financial year, in currency units, signed.

non_current.description: Part due beyond the next financial year, in currency units, signed.

position.description:
The net financial position with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6): gross debt − cash +
signed other items.

total.description: Net financial position, in currency units, signed, positive for net debt.

oneOf.description: Gross debt of the net financial position.
Quasi-equity, among the sources next to equity.

ShareholderLoansOverride.description: Another treatment of shareholder loans for one year: one destination, or a split.

oneOf.description: One destination for the whole of the loans this year.
Parts with their destinations, summing to the loans of the year.

ShareholderLoansPart.description: One part of a split of shareholder loans for one year.

amount.description: Amount of this part, in currency units, zero or more. The parts sum to the loans.

beyond_one_year.description:
For a `financial_debt` part: of which due beyond the next financial year, in currency
units; needed for the current and non-current parts of the net financial position.

label.description: What the part is, for example "Subordinated loan"; not blank.

Statutory.description: A year in the statutory form.

income_statement.description: Income statement aggregates (art. 2425; groupings of art. 2435-bis).

StatutoryBalanceSheet.description:
Balance sheet aggregates of art. 2424 (Appendix A.1). Each is optional; a node accepts a
total, its components or both.

accruals_and_deferred_income.description:
Liabilities E, accruals and deferred income, with the part beyond one year. Not needed
when liabilities E are given within D.

cash.description: C.IV cash and cash equivalents, in currency units.

current_assets.description: Total C, current assets, in currency units; checked against C.I + C.II + C.III + C.IV.

current_financial_assets.description:
C.III current financial assets (financial assets that are not fixed assets), in
currency units.

employee_severance_indemnity.description:
Liabilities C, employee severance indemnity (TFR), with the part beyond one year. Not
given: all non-current, reported.

equity.description: Liabilities A, equity, as a total or by its Roman numerals.

financial_fixed_assets.description:
B.III financial fixed assets, in currency units; needs the treatment
`financial_fixed_assets` when not zero.

fixed_assets.description: Total B, fixed assets, in currency units; checked against B.I + B.II + B.III.

intangible_assets.description: B.I intangible assets, net, or gross and accumulated amortisation.

payables.description: Liabilities D, payables, with their "of which" parts.

prepayments_and_accrued_income.description:
Assets D, prepayments and accrued income, with the part beyond one year. Not needed
when assets D are given within C.II.

provisions.description: Liabilities B, provisions for risks and charges.

receivables.description: C.II receivables with their "of which" parts.

subscribed_capital_unpaid.description:
Assets A, subscribed capital unpaid, in currency units; deducted from equity. Not given:
zero (D1), listed in `meta.defaults_applied`; give it to have total assets checked.

tangible_assets.description: B.II tangible assets, net, or gross and accumulated depreciation.

total_assets.description: Total assets, in currency units; checked against A + B + C + D.

total_liabilities_and_equity.description:
Total liabilities and equity, in currency units; checked against A + B + C + D + E and
against total assets.

StatutoryIncomeStatement.description: Income statement aggregates of art. 2425 by nature (Appendix A.2). Each is optional.

change_in_product_inventories.description:
A2 and A3 changes in inventories of work in progress, semi-finished and finished
products and in contract work in progress, in currency units, signed (positive for an
increase).

change_in_raw_material_inventories.description:
B11 change in inventories of raw materials, consumables and goods, in currency units,
signed (positive for a decrease, a cost).

costs_of_production.description: Total B, costs of production, in currency units, signed.

difference_between_value_and_costs_of_pr.description: A − B, difference between value and costs of production, in currency units, signed.

exchange_gains_and_losses.description: C17-bis exchange gains and losses, in currency units, signed (positive for a net gain).

financial_income_and_charges.description: Total C, financial income and charges, in currency units, signed.

income_from_equity_investments.description: C15 income from equity investments, in currency units.

income_taxes.description:
Item 20, income taxes for the year, current, deferred and prepaid, in currency units,
signed (positive for a tax charge).

interest_and_other_financial_charges.description: C17 interest and other financial charges, in currency units.

other_financial_income.description: C16 other financial income, in currency units.

other_operating_expenses.description: B14 other operating expenses, in currency units.

other_provisions.description: B13 other provisions, in currency units.

other_revenue_and_income.description: A5 other revenue and income, in currency units.

own_work_capitalised.description: A4 own work capitalised, in currency units.

personnel_costs.description: B9 personnel costs, in currency units.

profit_before_tax.description: Profit (loss) before tax, A − B ± C ± D, in currency units, signed.

profit_or_loss_for_the_year.description: Item 21, profit (loss) for the year, in currency units, signed.

provisions_for_risks.description: B12 provisions for risks, in currency units.

purchases.description: B6 raw materials, consumables and goods purchased, in currency units.

revaluations_of_financial_assets.description: D18 revaluations of financial assets, in currency units.

revenue.description: A1 revenue from sales and services, in currency units.

use_of_third_party_assets.description: B8 use of third-party assets, in currency units.

value_adjustments_of_financial_assets.description: Total D, value adjustments of financial assets, in currency units, signed.

value_of_production.description: Total A, value of production, in currency units, signed.

write_downs_of_financial_assets.description: D19 write-downs of financial assets, in currency units.

TreatmentOverrides.description: Per-year overrides (R9): only financial fixed assets and shareholder loans.

financial_fixed_assets.description:
Financial fixed assets (B.III) of this year: `{"destination": ...}` or
`{"split": [...]}`.

shareholder_loans.description: Shareholder loans of this year: `{"destination": ...}` or `{"split": [...]}`.

Treatments.description: Treatments stated once for the call (R8, R9, R17).

derivative_liabilities.description:
Derivative liabilities within provisions B: `financial_liability` or
`operating_provision`. Needed when the derivative part is given and not zero.
Default: none.

financial_fixed_assets.description:
Financial fixed assets (B.III): `operating`, `non_operating` or `financial_asset`.
Needed when B.III is given and not zero. Default: none.

shareholder_loans.description:
Shareholder loans (D.3): `financial_debt` or `quasi_equity`. Needed when the loans are
given and not zero. Default: none.

write_downs_of_receivables.description:
Write-downs of receivables (B10 d): `investing` or `operating`. Default: `investing`,
reported in `meta.defaults_applied`.

WithMaturity.description: An aggregate with its part due beyond the next financial year.

beyond_one_year.description: Of which due beyond the next financial year (non-current), in currency units.

WriteDownsOfReceivables.description: Where write-downs of receivables (B10 d) go (R17, Decision 17).

oneOf.description: Investing (extra-characteristic) result, below operating profit. The default.
Operating profit, below EBITDA (IFRS 18 practice for trade receivables).

date.description:
Balance sheet date, ISO 8601 `YYYY-MM-DD`. Optional; when missing, the order given is
taken as oldest first and the conventions say so.

label.description: Name of the year in the result, for example "2024". Optional; reported as given.

reclassified.description: Totals already reclassified (Appendix B). Give this or `statutory`, not both.

statutory.description:
The statutory aggregates of art. 2424 and 2425 (Appendix A). Give this or
`reclassified`, not both.

treatment_overrides.description:
For this year only, another treatment of financial fixed assets (B.III) or of
shareholder loans, or a split by amounts (R9). No other aggregate can be overridden.

adjustments.description:
Labelled adjustments of Appendix C, stated once for the call, each with one amount per
year (R10). They apply to statutory entries only. Default: none.

treatments.description:
Treatments stated once for the call, applied to every statutory year (R8, R9, R17).
A treatment is needed only for an aggregate given and not zero. Default: none, except
`write_downs_of_receivables`, which defaults to `investing`.

years.description:
One or more financial years, oldest first (R2), each in the `statutory` or the
`reclassified` form. When two consecutive entries both have a `date`, the later must be
one financial year after the earlier.
